behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.31.1: every audit event is named <kind>.<event>, carries the job or the login, the device, the operator, and the login user in its own fields and journald's, its message one line of key=value pairs, and records its statements, masked by the platforms' mask lists, in place of their digests; [platform.NAME] masks and crun.mask mask the audit's statements and the collection files; karvi-audit, a fourth executable, shows the audit trail from journald as a table; an outcome, a status, or a count is one present-tense word in every record, and the collection's replaced and kept are replace and keep; the configuration registry moves from 30 to 31, the execution plan from 13 to 14, the command record from 3 to 4, the job manifest and summary from 4 to 5, the plan report from 2 to 3, the scoreboard from 3 to 4, and the audit from 1 to 2, every other counter 0.31.1's (configuration schema 6, daemon IPC 12, credential package 2); the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.31.1 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.31.1 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)

configuration_migration.notes: the configuration schema is unchanged from v0.10.0; config.schema-version stays 6; registry 31, moved from v0.31.1's 30 by [platform.NAME] masks and crun.mask

native_dependency.reason: every build carries the scrapligo-v1 adapter; built from the vendored tree
